plan.title: Mandatory Vendor Documents Exclude GST Certificate

steps.note: Configure the tenant so PAN is the only mandatory vendor document.

args.goal: Use VMS / VRP Import to import vendors from the enterprise's existing VMS/VRP, then open the vendor profile submission or approval requirements screen and verify that PAN is required while GST Certificate is not required.

steps.note: Perform and observe the VMS/VRP import flow and its resulting mandatory-document requirements, which have no dedicated domain step.
Confirm PAN remains in the required document list.
Confirm GST Certificate is no longer included in the required document list.
Ensure the observed vendor requirements screen has no application or rendering errors.
